environment.description: Same IoT gateway code deployed inside a lightweight container runtime (runc) with a custom OCI bundle. The container's rootfs is assembled via overlayfs with a minimal Alpine base. The process runs under a dedicated namespace with pivot_root applied to /srv/iot-jail which contains only: /usr/local/bin/iot-mgmt (a no-op stub returning version info), /etc/iot/devices/ (empty writable dir), /var/log/iot/ (writable), and Python runtime libraries. The mount namespace has MS_NOSUID on all mounts and a seccomp profile (allowlist: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, socket, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, clone, execve, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, futex, getpid, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, fcntl, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, getcwd, stat, lstat, readlink, getdents64, chdir, pipe2, dup2, wait4 — notably NO pivot_root, mount, ptrace, or personality). The container has no /etc/shadow, no /etc/passwd with real hashes, no sensitive host files bind-mounted. The iot-mgmt stub binary is mode 0755 (no setuid) and simply prints '{"version": "2.1.0"}' regardless of arguments. Network namespace restricts outbound to the MQTT broker IP only (10.0.5.12/32) via nftables rules applied in the network namespace.

config.rootfs: minimal overlayfs: Alpine base + Python3.11 + app code only
config.iot_mgmt_binary: /usr/local/bin/iot-mgmt is a shell script printing version JSON, mode 0755, no setuid
config.network_namespace: nftables OUTPUT chain: ACCEPT only to 10.0.5.12/32:1883, DROP all else
config.no_host_mounts: no /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd (uses nss with static entries), no /proc/1/root escape
